verdict.rationale: Mercury's Cards API changelog says users can "control card lifecycle states" through the API, which plausibly includes freezing a card, and spend controls and limits are documented. Nothing explicitly describes an instant freeze for a lost or stolen card, or ordering a replacement. Missing for 10: explicit instant freeze/unfreeze documentation (dashboard or app), any replacement-card ordering flow, a lost/stolen reporting workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
